chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, passed by a place in al-Mabādiʿ and said: “An excellent place is the bathhouse.”

key_terms.بِالْمَبَاضِعِ: at al-Mabādiʿ, the place mentioned in the report
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نِعْمَ: an expression of praise meaning excellent

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about the bathhouse?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a statement of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم praising the bathhouse. It indicates a favorable view of the bathhouse as a beneficial place, relevant to discussions of etiquette and rulings concerning entering it.
